rationale.text: A French page with lang="fr-FR". The glossary says the language code indication has two parts separated by a hyphen, that the option after it is left to the author, and that validity concerns only the code part before the hyphen; fr is an ISO 639-1 code. The custom check compares only that part and answers no_fault. Relevance has no check, so the finding is needs_review: not_enabled at fail_only, alternative_unresolved at full.

citations.quote: L’indication du code de langue est constituée de deux parties séparées par un tiret
[option] est une indication laissée à l’appréciation de l’auteur.
L’indication du code de langue ne concerne que la partie [code] avant le tiret.
